provenance.method: Bounded review of current GOV.UK disabled-transport train support information; no eligibility is inferred.

name: GOV.UK transport support for disabled rail passengers
description: GOV.UK overview of rail assistance, accessible-facility information and Disabled Persons Railcard signposting for disabled travellers.
intended_use: Planning what assistance or accessibility information to inspect before a rail journey.
audience_or_context: Disabled rail passengers in Great Britain; train-company facilities, eligibility and journey-specific arrangements vary.
limitations: ND Oracle does not determine Railcard eligibility or guarantee assistance on a particular service.
Northern Ireland rail services use different operators and arrangements.
cost_or_access_notes: Public guidance is free; fares, railcards and travel costs vary.
